any: The crossing at Kamakurakokomae, from the hill road. The road drops to the rails, and past the rails there is only the sea.
Kamakurakokomae Station. One platform, one track, and the whole of Sagami Bay in front of it, with Enoshima to the west.
Shichirigahama. Dark sand, a long swell coming in, and Enoshima lying on the horizon.
Inamuragasaki. From the cape the coast road runs west along the bay, all the way to Enoshima.
dusk: People come to the cape for this hour: Enoshima goes black against the sky, and on a clear evening Fuji stands behind it.

any: The sea wall at Koshigoe's fishing harbour. Enoshima is so near from here that you could row to it.
